```{r}
library(BPCells)
library(tidyverse)
library(sccomp)
library(readxl)
set.seed(1)
all_ge = open_matrix_dir("../shared objs and code/post_qc_decontx_counts/")
genes_to_remove <- rownames(all_ge)[grepl("^Gm|Rik", rownames(all_ge))]

animal_metadata = readr::read_csv("../shared objs and code/mouse_meta.csv")
animal_metadata$ID = as.character(animal_metadata$ID)
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% dplyr::select("ID", "Sex", "Line.short", "Genotype", "Age (months)") %>% dplyr::rename("age" = "Age (months)","strain" = "Line.short", "sex" = "Sex", "genotype" = "Genotype", "animal_id" = "ID")
#load animal phenotype data
animal_phenotype_data = read.csv("../shared objs and code/YM_CFC_BW_SM_calo_AB_individual_data_cleaned_20240826.csv")
animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice = animal_phenotype_data %>% filter(ID %in% animal_metadata$animal_id)
#add age of death, then filter behavioral metadata for this timepoint, since some mice were phenotyped more than just prior to death. But our analysis will focus on the data collected from the timepoint prior to death. 

animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice$age_at_death = animal_metadata$age[match(animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice$ID, animal_metadata$animal_id)]
animal_phenotype_data_at_death = animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice %>% filter(age_at_death == AgeGrp)


#add CFA and CFM (cognitive metrics) for each mouse
animal_metadata$CFA = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$CFC.PS4[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]
animal_metadata$CFM = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$CFM.Total[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]


#add Weight (metabolic/physical metrics) for each mouse
animal_metadata$Weight = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$Weight[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]
#z score continuous variables (Weight, CFA, CFM)
animal_metadata <- animal_metadata %>%
  mutate(across(c(Weight, CFA, CFM), ~ scale(.x, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)[, 1]))

#change age_at_death to "young" for 6 and "old" for 14
animal_metadata$age = case_when(
  animal_metadata$age == "6" ~ "young",
  animal_metadata$age == "14" ~ "old",
  .default = NA
)

#load neuronal + non-neuronal assignments
non_neuronal_cluster_assignments = readRDS("../shared objs and code/non_neuronal_assignments.rds")
neuronal_cluster_assignments = readRDS("../shared objs and code/neuronal_number_ids_cluster_assignments.rds")
neuronal_names  = names(neuronal_cluster_assignments)
#append neuronal to show the class
neuronal_cluster_assignments = paste0("neuronal-",neuronal_cluster_assignments)
names(neuronal_cluster_assignments) = neuronal_names
cluster_assignments = c(non_neuronal_cluster_assignments, neuronal_cluster_assignments)

#create df with cell id and cluster for each cell
cell_metadata = data.frame(cell_id = names(cluster_assignments), cluster = cluster_assignments)
#get animal id from name of cell ()
cell_metadata$animal_id = gsub(".*_(\\d+)-.*", "\\1", cell_metadata$cell_id)
#join cell metadata with animal metadata by animal_id
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% left_join(animal_metadata, by = "animal_id")

#Remove the single animal w/o CFC/CFA measurements (could be potential confound)
animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm = animal_metadata %>% filter(is.na(CFM) | is.na(CFA)) %>% pull(animal_id) %>% unique %>% as.character
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm)

#identify animals with less than 1000 cells and remove them from dataset (low number of cells for an animal may throw off proportions)
animals_less_1000_cells = cell_metadata$animal_id %>% table %>% .[. < 1000] %>% names
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animals_less_1000_cells)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% droplevels()

#remove tcells since only one cluster
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(cluster != "tcells")

# Split  on cell class
cell_metadata$cell_class <- sub("[-_].*", "", cell_metadata$cluster)

#Identify classes with only one cluster (remove from proportion analysis)
classes_one_cluster = cell_metadata %>% ungroup() %>% distinct(cluster, cell_class) %>% ungroup() %>% count(cell_class) %>% filter(n == 1) %>% pull(cell_class)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(!cell_class %in% classes_one_cluster) %>% droplevels()
all_classes = cell_metadata$cell_class %>% unique
all_classes = all_classes[all_classes != "neuronal"]


```

```{r}
cur_meta = cell_metadata %>% filter(cell_class == "microglia")
cur_ge = all_ge[,cur_meta$cell_id]
cur_ge_ln <- multiply_cols(cur_ge, 1/Matrix::colSums(cur_ge))
cur_ge_ln <- log1p(cur_ge_ln * 1e6) # Log transform

#find markers using marker_features
cur_markers = marker_features(cur_ge_ln, cur_meta$cluster)
cur_markers$l2fc = (cur_markers$foreground_mean - cur_markers$background_mean)/log(2)
```

```{r}

subtype_specific_genes = c("Insyn2b", "Ccdc85a", "ND4", "Ptgds", "Myo1e", "Etl4", "P2ry13", "Sting1", "C1qa", "Ifit3", "Ifitm3", "Pcdh9","Nrxn1")
selected_genes = c("P2ry12", "Tmem119", "Cx3cr1","Trem2", "Apoe","Xist","Tsix", "Uty") %>% unique
selected_genes = c(subtype_specific_genes, selected_genes) %>% unique

percent_pseudobulk = all_ge[selected_genes,cur_meta$cell_id] > 0
percent_pseudobulk = percent_pseudobulk %>% pseudobulk_matrix(cell_groups = cur_meta$cluster, method = "mean", threads = 8L)

ln_pseudobulk = cur_ge_ln[selected_genes,]
ln_pseudobulk = ln_pseudobulk %>% pseudobulk_matrix(cell_groups = cur_meta$cluster, method = "mean", threads = 8L)

dotplot_df = data.frame()
for(gene in selected_genes){
  for(cluster in unique(cur_meta$cluster)){
    avg_exp = ln_pseudobulk[gene, cluster]
    pct_exp = percent_pseudobulk[gene, cluster] * 100
    dotplot_df = rbind(dotplot_df, data.frame(gene = gene, cluster = cluster, avg_exp = avg_exp, pct_exp = pct_exp))
  }
}


```


```{r}
# Define specific ordering for Clusters and Genes as requested
cluster_order <- c("microglia-1", "microglia-6", "microglia-7", "microglia-3", 
                   "microglia-4", "microglia-5", 
                   "microglia-2")

gene_order <- selected_genes

# Apply factors to dataframe
dotplot_df$cluster <- factor(dotplot_df$cluster, levels = rev(cluster_order)) # rev puts cluster 1 at top of Y-axis
dotplot_df$gene <- factor(dotplot_df$gene, levels = gene_order)

#zscore by gene
dotplot_df <- dotplot_df %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  mutate(avg_exp = scale(avg_exp, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)[, 1]) %>%
  ungroup()




```


```{r}
main_plot_genes = selected_genes


#title case the cluster names for plotting
dotplot_df$cluster = str_to_title(dotplot_df$cluster)

dotplot_df_with_new_cluster_names = dotplot_df %>% mutate(cluster = case_when(
  cluster == "Microglia-1" ~ "Microglia-1 (Homeostatic)",
  cluster == "Microglia-2" ~ "Microglia-2 (Interferon Associated)",
  cluster == "Microglia-3" ~ "Microglia-3 (Tsix/Xist)",
  cluster == "Microglia-4" ~ "Microglia-4 (Stage 2 DAMs)",
  cluster == "Microglia-5" ~ "Microglia-5 (Stage 1 DAMs)",
  cluster == "Microglia-6" ~ "Microglia-6 (Homeostatic)",
  cluster == "Microglia-7" ~ "Microglia-7 (Tsix/Xist)",
  .default = cluster
))

micro_marker_plot = ggplot(dotplot_df_with_new_cluster_names %>% filter(gene %in% main_plot_genes), aes(x = gene, y = cluster, fill = avg_exp, size = pct_exp)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 25,name = "Percent\nExpressed") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(mid = "white",high = "#D55E00",low = "#0072B2",name = "Scaled\nExpression") +
  ggtitle("Microglial Cluster Markers") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +  
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 45)) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 70,hjust = .5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 50),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 50),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold",size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.size = unit(2, "cm")
  ) +
labs(x = "Gene", y = "Microglial Cluster")
ggsave("microglia_marker_dotplot.pdf", micro_marker_plot, width = 22, height = 10)
```


```{r}

dam_subcluster_genes =  c("Lpl", "Axl", "Itgax", "Spp1", "Cd9", "Ccl6", "Csf1")

percent_pseudobulk = all_ge[dam_subcluster_genes,cur_meta$cell_id] > 0
percent_pseudobulk = percent_pseudobulk %>% pseudobulk_matrix(cell_groups = cur_meta$cluster, method = "mean", threads = 8L)

ln_pseudobulk = cur_ge_ln[dam_subcluster_genes,]
ln_pseudobulk = ln_pseudobulk %>% pseudobulk_matrix(cell_groups = cur_meta$cluster, method = "mean", threads = 8L)

dotplot_df = data.frame()
for(gene in dam_subcluster_genes){
  for(cluster in unique(cur_meta$cluster)){
    avg_exp = ln_pseudobulk[gene, cluster]
    pct_exp = percent_pseudobulk[gene, cluster] * 100
    dotplot_df = rbind(dotplot_df, data.frame(gene = gene, cluster = cluster, avg_exp = avg_exp, pct_exp = pct_exp))
  }
}


# Define specific ordering for Clusters and Genes as requested
cluster_order <- c("microglia-1", "microglia-6", "microglia-7", "microglia-3", 
                   "microglia-4", "microglia-5", 
                   "microglia-2")

gene_order <- dam_subcluster_genes

# Apply factors to dataframe
dotplot_df$cluster <- factor(dotplot_df$cluster, levels = rev(cluster_order)) # rev puts cluster 1 at top of Y-axis
dotplot_df$gene <- factor(dotplot_df$gene, levels = gene_order)

#zscore by gene
dotplot_df <- dotplot_df %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  mutate(avg_exp = scale(avg_exp, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)[, 1]) %>%
  ungroup()


dotplot_df$cluster = factor(dotplot_df$cluster, levels = rev(c("microglia-5","microglia-4","microglia-3")))
dam_subcluster_genes_plot = ggplot(dotplot_df %>% filter(cluster %in% c("microglia-4","microglia-5","microglia-3")), aes(x = gene, y = cluster)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = pct_exp, fill = avg_exp), shape = 21, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Scaled\nLog-Normalized\nExpression") +
  scale_size(range = c(1, 8), name = "% Expressed") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Helvetica",base_size = 14) + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1.2, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(x = "", y = "", title = "DAM Subtype Markers Distinguish Stage 1 vs Stage 2")

ggsave("microglia_dam_subcluster_marker_dotplot.pdf", dam_subcluster_genes_plot, width = 10, height = 4)
```
